players.product: Triple Alpha quantum software development environment (hardware-agnostic compiler / deployment), run on an in-house quantum hardware testbed

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Dr. Joe Fitzsimons: the second testbed system, a 256-qubit trapped-ion system from IonQ due to be installed in Dublin next year, should - if it lives up to spec on qubit count and gate and measurement fidelities - put the system right on the cusp of an advantage for certain chemistry problems; he adds Horizon will not know until it has the system whether it will actually show a real advantage.
